mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_id, i.inquiry_title, i.inquiry_content, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.answer_status, i.answer_content, i.user_id, i.admin_id, u.user_nickname AS userNickname, a.user_nickname AS adminNickname FROM tb_inquiry i JOIN tb_user u ON i.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_user a ON i.admin_id = a.user_id WHERE (#{answerStatus} IS NULL OR answer_status = #{answerStatus}) ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT i.inquiry_id, i.inquiry_title, i.inquiry_content, i.created_at, i.updated_at, i.answer_status, i.answer_content, i.user_id, i.admin_id, u.user_nickname As userNickname FROM tb_inquiry i JOIN tb_user u ON i.user_id = u.user_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_inquiry WHERE user_id = #{userId}
